name: nesty
description: A Bitsy-style editor for making real NES games in the browser — compiles to a genuine .nes ROM.
author: Àlvar Amat (delacannon) <delacannon@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/asm6502 --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/compiler --noEmit && tsc -p apps/editor && tsc -p apps/web
